purpose: Create, edit, or install a preset for a typed automation graph, with optional AI proposals, readiness feedback, safe draft handling, and explicit publishing.
primaryGoal: Configure a name, business vehicle target, trigger, optional conditions, and ordered actions; review and explicitly save without losing work.

dataSources.name: useAutomation
dataSources.behavior: Positive numeric ID enablement, detail query key, abort signal forwarding; page hydrates the editor once from retained server data.
dataSources.verification: Source registration only; handler response, permissions and actual requests unverified.

dataSources.name: useAutomationPreset
dataSources.behavior: Optional preset URL parameter, encoded identifier, static stale time, enabled only with an ID; seeds name/description and all graph arrays.

dataSources.name: useVehicles
dataSources.behavior: Abort signal, FAST stale time, safeArray; local target options retain All vehicles represented by null. This is the automation's business target, not another workspace picker.

dataSources.name: useNotificationChannels
dataSources.behavior: Abort signal and safeArray. ActionBuilder chooses the first enabled channel, otherwise the first channel, otherwise ID 0; disabled channel options remain represented.

dataSources.name: useGeofences
dataSources.behavior: Shared query key, abort signal and safeArray. Both trigger and condition editors use persisted place IDs. Trigger editor includes loading/error/empty explanations and retry.

dataSources.name: useCreateAutomationFull / useUpdateAutomationFull / useTestRunAutomation
dataSources.behavior: Live-mode-required writes; always network mode; localized toast feedback. Create invalidates/broadcasts the list; update also invalidates/broadcasts detail; test run invalidates history. Page saves the normalized graph, clears dirty/draft on success, retains returned conflicts and stays in the editor if conflicts exist.
dataSources.verification: No mutation executed; conflict semantics described only from client consumption and registered routes.

dataSources.name: AINLAutomationBuilder / AIGeofenceAwareAutomationSuggestions with useAiStream
dataSources.behavior: Workspace selected vehicle supplies AI scope independently from the saved automation target. NL requires positive finite vehicle ID and trimmed prompt up to 4096 characters. Geofence proposal captures tool_result, offers Apply to form only for status ok, and cancels/resets on vehicle switch. AI feature HOC hides deliberately disabled features; this is not accidental missing-data section hiding.
dataSources.verification: Registered paths and consumer source inspected; useAiStream internals, feature settings sources, stream protocol at runtime and provider availability not verified.

dataSources.name: Local editor, draft, concurrency and trust contracts
dataSources.owner: Existing application hooks and page form state
dataSources.behavior: useFormDraft version 1 with 1500ms debounce and dirty/hydrated/not-saving persistence gate; source-specific keys; edit leases; browser and in-app navigation guards; explicit discard confirmation; OperationalBrief derives four editor-only metrics via useOperationalMetrics. useDataState distinguishes fatal from refresh errors. OperationalMode blocks writes offline/as-of.
dataSources.verification: Hook usage inspected; draft/lease/guard implementations and browser persistence were not exercised.

components.name: PageLayout
components.contract: Localized title/subtitle, breadcrumb labels, back action, loading/error branches; existing shell remains owner of workspace scope.

components.name: Button, Input, Textarea, Select, Toggle, Badge, GlassPanel, PanelTitle, Text, ConfirmDialog, VisuallyHidden
components.contract: Reuse field identity/help, native validation, semantic control variants and confirmation focus engine. No new surface/overlay system.

components.name: OperationalBrief, FormSection and trust/safety banners
components.contract: Four editor metrics with provenance, enabled/disabled status, readiness, dirty freshness; retain OperationalWriteNotice, EditConflictBanner, DraftRecoveryBanner, StaleRefreshWarning and AlertBanner.

components.name: TriggerConfigurator, ConditionBuilder, ActionBuilder, ConflictWarnings
components.contract: Four typed trigger kinds, four typed condition kinds, four action kinds, ordered actions and server-returned warnings; keep the current action helper source-closure decomposition.

components.name: ActionStepRow, ActionFields, action field renderers, UnitInput, UnitListInput, WeekdaySelect
components.contract: Preserve min-w-0 responsive action rows, useId fields, 44px reorder/delete controls, guided command inputs, advanced JSON with native validity, display-only physical inputs, typed setting values and target IDs.

components.name: AIFeatureCard, withAiFeature and two automation AI consumers
components.contract: Shared canStart/stream lifecycle, localized contextual accessible names, input/children slots, output, feature gating; preserve actual user review before publishing.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Trigger and condition geofence selectors consume the same hook but only TriggerConfigurator surfaces loading/error/empty/retry. Query caching is already shared; presentation-state handling is inconsistent.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing data-state and field hint/retry patterns in ConditionBuilder, not a new query or speculative universal picker.

sourceStrategy: Page stacks build canvas and assistant until xl, then uses a 2:1 split with sticky assistant (AutomationBuilderPage.tsx:754-758,872-876).
General vehicle/enabled fields stack until sm (AutomationBuilderPage.tsx:778).
Footer actions wrap and use min-h-11 (AutomationBuilderPage.tsx:973-1010).
Migrated action rows use min-w-0, full-width fields, responsive grids, wrapLabel and 44px controls (ActionStepRow.tsx:33-76; ActionNotificationFields.tsx:16-38).

issues.detail: Condition type is fixed w-56 inside a padded panel and a flex row that also reserves a separate remove button; other fields use w-44/w-56/w-52. Unlike migrated action rows, the enclosing flexible child lacks min-w-0. This is a narrow-container overflow risk, not measured viewport failure.
issues.fix: Retain every field and condition; adopt existing action-row min-w-0/full-width stacking and bounded wide-screen field sizes.

issues.detail: Proposal uses a non-wrapping flex row with shrink-0 Apply control and no min-w-0/break-word constraints on proposal content. Long names, descriptions and validator errors may compete with the action in the narrow assistant rail.
issues.fix: Use existing responsive wrapping and typography contracts; stack the Apply action when allocated width is small and keep full proposal/validation content.

requiredQA: sticky assistant with long stream output

sourceStrengths: Named assistant landmark, native form, localized shared field labels and required name.
Readiness icons are decorative and include localized VisuallyHidden complete/incomplete text (AutomationBuilderPage.tsx:885-905).
ConflictWarnings uses role=alert and decorative icons (ConflictWarnings.tsx:23-41).
Action rows retain localized move/remove names, explicit action-kind IDs and 44px controls (ActionStepRow.tsx:33-76).
Advanced command JSON sets custom validity and shared Textarea error feedback (ActionCommandFields.tsx:97-143).

issues.detail: Condition type Select receives a label only for index 0; later condition type controls have no caller label, aria-label or aria-labelledby in this render path. Select internals were not inspected, so the resulting accessible name is not browser-proved.
issues.fix: Give every condition type control a localized label or explicit accessible name including row context; preserve visible grouping and typed values.

issues.rule: MDC-020 / MDC-040 / touch target and focus
issues.detail: Cron mode button overrides shared sizing with !h-auto !px-0 !py-0 and text-xs. Condition remove uses size sm without the 44px override present on action remove. These need target/spacing review, not a fabricated WCAG measurement.
issues.fix: Keep button semantics and both cron modes; use shared wrapping/minimum target sizing and verify spacing exceptions on the actual interface.

issues.detail: Page validation returns a single saveError rendered near the bottom, without per-field error props or focusing the invalid configuration. Native required name/UnitInput and JSON validity remain separate protections.
issues.fix: Retain current validation and shared AlertBanner; associate validation with relevant existing fields and provide a focus path for errors spanning trigger/condition/action editors.

accessibility.limits: Keyboard order, actual accessible names, focus restoration/trapping, effective contrast, forced colors, reduced motion and touch geometry not exercised.

states.initialLoading: Edit without retained automation uses PageLayout loading; actual skeleton geometry uninspected (AutomationBuilderPage.tsx:639-650).
states.empty: Edit not found and unset trigger use EmptyState; zero optional conditions is valid and still offers Add condition. No channel options render No channels configured (ActionNotificationFields.tsx:20-22).
states.fatalError: Edit passes fatal error into PageLayout; exact retry behavior of that shared renderer not inspected (AutomationBuilderPage.tsx:653-663).
states.refreshStale: useDataState and StaleRefreshWarning retain an editor when data exists (AutomationBuilderPage.tsx:326,696).
states.offlineHistorical: OperationalWriteNotice plus operationalMode.canWrite disable save/test; request also asserts write policy. Editor/draft remains available (AutomationBuilderPage.tsx:704-709,977-998; useOperationalMode.tsx:50-98; client.ts:378).
states.pendingSuccessError: Save/test have loading states, returned conflicts stay on screen after successful save, test success badge and hook toasts remain; test failure uses hook toast rather than inline page status.
states.draftConcurrency: DraftRecoveryBanner only for new non-preset draft; edit lease and navigation/discard confirmations are existing safeguards, not new proposals.

issues.detail: Preset query consumes only data. With preset parameter and pending/failed/missing preset, normal blank editor renders with default climate_on action; hydration never completes until preset exists. No preset-specific loading/error/retry state explains why installation did not populate.
issues.fix: Keep preset identity and graph seeding; expose independent loading/fatal/refresh/empty states with retry and prevent unintended blank-preset publishing without review.

issues.detail: Vehicle/channel reads consume only data and default undefined to empty options; failure or loading is indistinguishable from genuinely no vehicles/channels. ConditionBuilder similarly ignores geofence query state. Existing form values can remain even when unavailable options do not explain them.
issues.fix: Retain target IDs and draft; use existing source trust/hint/retry contracts for each auxiliary query without hiding unrelated sections or substituting measured emptiness.

issues.detail: Checklist enumerates only name, trigger and actions, but allReady also requires geofence conditions to have a place. All three items can read complete while badge remains Not ready yet with no condition checklist explanation.
issues.fix: Reflect existing condition validation in readiness feedback without weakening the validator or claiming server execution readiness.

visualIssues.detail: Shared AI CTA overrides neutral outline styling with cyan borders/background/text/hover/focus; badge independently adds cyan chrome at line 214. Two stacked AI cards compete with the primary automation-publishing action. This is source-confirmed fixed-hue saturation/noise risk, not measured rendered intensity.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing control/severity/theme tokens and restrained AI identity; preserve labels, contextual accessible names, prompt, stream output and explicit action behavior.

visualIssues.detail: Nested proposal uses fixed cyan tint/border, text-cyan-300 label and ad-hoc text-xs/text-sm instead of role wrappers. Fixed rose-300 rejection copy also needs effective light-theme contrast review.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing neutral surface and semantic status/typography roles, retaining proposal name, description, graph counts, validation errors, rejection message and Apply action.

visualIssues.detail: Readiness icons use fixed cyan-300 and emerald-300; ConditionBuilder delete uses fixed red-400/red-300 at line 226. These are residual theme-independent accents; no pure-white, neon or glow strings were found in the audited page itself.
visualIssues.fix: Prefer existing semantic tokens and quieter readiness decoration while retaining textual complete/incomplete status and user theme preferences.

architectureIssues.detail: AI CTA omits type="button" while mounted inside the page's native onSubmit form. Button forwards native props and supplies no default type (Button.tsx:64-80). Geofence Apply also omits type (AIGeofenceAwareAutomationSuggestions.tsx:290). Native button default is submit, so drafting/applying can also invoke page save when validation permits. Source composition confirms the risk; no production write was attempted.
architectureIssues.fix: Set explicit type="button" on both shared non-publishing actions and verify they never submit the enclosing editor. Do not globally change Button defaults or alter the canonical Save/Create submit action.

architectureIssues.detail: Hydration and payload normalization preserve every trigger, but the editor displays only triggers[0] and any trigger change replaces the array with one entry. A multi-trigger server/preset/AI graph can contain invisible trigger configuration that is lost on editing the first trigger.
architectureIssues.fix: Confirm supported graph cardinality with the existing typed API contract before implementation; preserve all loaded steps and make additional supported triggers inspectable/editable, or explain unsupported editing without silently truncating. Do not invent backend multi-trigger semantics.

architectureIssues.detail: Natural-language card describes a draft to review and save below, but onEvent is a no-op and the page passes no apply callback. Unlike the geofence panel, this inspected path displays stream text only and does not populate the typed editor.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current stream output and clarify existing workflow; only add typed apply integration if established tool-result contracts support it, through the existing normalizers and explicit review/save path.

priority.rationale: Resolve accidental enclosing-form submission before presentation adoption. Then close source-state/readiness/accessible-field gaps and verify graph preservation. Keep inherited modernized action editors and OperationalBrief rather than reverting them.
order: Condition accessible names and narrow layouts

requiredSharedChanges.name: Non-publishing AI actions inside forms
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Keep AIFeatureCard canStart, stream, onAction, inputSlot, children, contextual names, loading/disabled states. Its CTA and geofence Apply must use native type=button; only page Save/Create submits.
dependsOn: Existing propose-only typed draft review flow
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Focused enclosing-form test: Draft/Suggest/Apply click must not submit; intentional Save/Create still submits; disabled/pending behavior unchanged.

requiredSharedChanges.name: Restrained AI card and responsive proposal contract
requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Reuse existing outline button, neutral surface, role typography and semantic status tokens; retain prompt slot, full text/activity/usage output, invalid proposal details, Apply availability, feature-off gating and long-content responsive reflow. No new component or variant demonstrated necessary.
dependsOn: Preserved stream and feature gate APIs
requiredSharedChanges.acceptance: Review both cards in dark/light/forced colors, narrow rail, long localized content, pending/error/rejected/ok states; retain all output and explicit review actions.

competingImplementations.detail: Condition rows retain fixed-width GlassPanel/flex field composition, while action rows already have decomposed responsive FormSection owners. This is a local implementation inconsistency, not evidence of a second global layout engine.
competingImplementations.fix: Reuse established primitive/form/layout contracts for condition modernization; keep action helper source-closure files, typed settings, SI inputs and existing accessibility improvements.

preservation.hashMethod: PowerShell Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 on original bytes; line count from (Get-Content).Count.
preservation.sectionCountDefinition: Ten named presentation groups, excluding page header, safety/status banners, form feedback and dialog. AI groups are feature-gated and preset hint is create-only; this is not a rendered-count claim.
preservation.sourceCountNotes: Lexical opening-tag counts on page only; two trigger GlassPanels are mutually exclusive. Nested components contribute additional forms/surfaces and are not counted as page literals.
actions: Back to automations and Cancel with dirty confirmation; browser/in-app navigation guards
Name/description edits, automation business vehicle target including All vehicles, enabled toggle
Trigger type selection; schedule time/weekdays/advanced cron/timezone; vehicle event; geofence place/event/dwell; signal/operator/typed threshold/any change
Add/remove/change conditions; signal comparisons/range/list, time window/weekdays/timezone, geofence state, other automation ID/state
Add/remove/reorder/change ordered actions; vehicle commands and guided parameters/advanced JSON, channel/message, typed setting value, target automation
Draft/Suggest AI and valid geofence Apply to form; preserve feature settings and stream output
Create/Save, returned conflict review, test run saved/current ID, success/error feedback
Discard recovered new draft; geofence retry and Manage places navigation
dataBehavior: Trim name/description only at payload creation; keep discriminated step normalization with optional zero/false values preserved.
Default enabled=true; vehicle_id=null; no trigger/conditions; initial climate_on action. Do not replace real configuration with fixtures.
Retain every typed step property, action order and full hydrated arrays. Input union distribution in stepInputTypes.ts:9-25 is load-bearing.
Keep existing SI-aware UnitInput/UnitListInput at display boundary and numeric/raw payload values; no unit or backend field rename is authorized by this audit.
Preserve source-specific draft/lease keys, hydration reset on actual source switch, version/debounce/persistence gate, unsaved guards and explicit confirmation.
Edit/preset hydration currently discards recovered draft in favor of canonical source; report this existing behavior, do not silently change it during presentation work.
Keep separate AI workspace vehicle scope and automation business target; preserve explicit All vehicles choice.
Preserve query keys, abort signals, stale policies, live-mode write assertion, toast/invalidation/broadcast behaviors.
Retain OperationalBrief four editor-only metrics and provenance: no execution-history or backend readiness claim.
Keep conditional feedback visible when applicable; no export/chart exists in this page snapshot, so do not invent one.

evidenceLimits.scope: One shared mounted page item plus directly relevant presentation/data dependencies; no sibling page audit or application-wide inventory.
evidenceLimits.routeVerification: App.tsx:191,618-619 establishes lazy route declarations only, not authenticated mount/reachability.
evidenceLimits.runtime: Not exercised; no browser, server, network requests, mutations or production actions.
evidenceLimits.visual: No screenshots or rendered theme review; fixed color/size classes indicate source risks, not measured saturation/glow or contrast failure.
evidenceLimits.backend: Router registrations only; no handler, DB, graph cardinality, conflict algorithm, authorization or execution proof. Existing dwell_minutes spelling is recorded, not interpreted as permission to change wire units.
evidenceLimits.dependencies: Shared PageLayout, field/select, trust-banner, motion, data-state implementation, draft/guard/lease hooks, useAiStream and token resolvers were not exhaustively inspected; imported usage is not implementation acceptance.
evidenceLimits.sourceDrift: Concurrent writers may change dependencies. Page hash pins this read snapshot; final readback checks that page hash remains the same, not a Git cleanliness claim.
